The source is available under the included CDDL license. Build recipe:

LibRaw COPYRIGHT and DCB's BSD notice accompany this file.
Built without external DNG SDK, JPEG, LCMS, RawSpeed, X3FTOOLS or demosaic packs.
Android's system zlib is used for floating point DNG decompression.
